# Automation Outlet

> UK broker of surplus and obsolete industrial automation parts: PLCs, I/O, HMIs, drives, servo motors and controls from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, GE Fanuc, Omron, Schneider, Mitsubishi and others. Free wanted-list sourcing and free PLC obsolescence checks. Based near March, Cambridgeshire, UK. Email: info@automation-outlet.co.uk

Automation Outlet buys surplus stock outright or sells it on consignment for factories and engineers, and sources hard-to-find discontinued parts through a UK surplus network. Lifecycle information on this site links to manufacturer notices.

## Key pages
- [Current stock](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/buy-stock.html): parts in stock with condition and quantity
- [Obsolete parts sourcing / wanted list](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/obsolete-parts-sourcing.html): send part numbers, free search, no obligation
- [Free PLC obsolescence check](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/obsolescence-check.html)
- [PLC lifecycle guide](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/plc-lifecycle.html): status, last-order dates and successors for about 60 PLC families, with manufacturer sources
- [Sell surplus](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/sell-surplus.html) and [Consignment](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/consignment.html)
- [Buyer Network alerts](https://www.automation-outlet.co.uk/buyer-alerts.html)
